source: Lantmäteriet Markhöjdmodell 1 m (RH 2000), the 64 published level-0 tiles of the veckefjarden v2 ground, sampled through the derived legacy bridge (geobuild/dtm-lib.mjs); the model's OSM rings from geobuild/course-model.json
method: flat cells (4-neighbours within 0.03 m) labelled; the lake = components within 0.2 m of 0.28 m RH 2000 that are >= 10 ha or within 60 m of one; one shore cell within 0.1 m of the plate added at the edge; the mask boundary traced, smoothed once (3-tap), Douglas-Peucker 0.5 m within 300 m of a hole line / 1.5 m beyond, densified to 2 m / 6 m. The spliced ring is the boolean (OSM water outside the DTM window) ∪ (laser water inside it), assembled along the window edge by perimeter position. Ponds: DTM inside the OSM ring, median and p05-p95; a plate exists when >= 60% of the interior lies within ±0.075 m of the median, and is then flooded from the interior through cells within 0.1 m of it and traced.

datum.note: levelLegacy = levelRH2000 + DATUM; the model's lakeLevel 21.59 is AWS Terrarium on an unknown datum

window.note: the DTM window is a rectangle rotated 3.28° in the legacy frame; quad is its outline, x0..z1 its bbox
